newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Cold temperatures hit.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Cold temperatures hit.

text.p: Freezing temperatures engulfed much of the central and northern U.S. Plains Thursday, raising the possibility of cold-related damage to the hard red winter wheat crop.

One grain merchandiser in north central Oklahoma said the temperature dropped at least 20 degrees in the space of an hour Thursday morning. The latest report showed the temperature at 15 degrees, with a sub-zero wind chill. Most of Kansas was in the single digits Farenheit Thursday morning.
But many grain merchandisers said it was still premature to get worried over the condition of the crop.
"Farmers are not getting worried too much about the cold weather, at least for now," a central Kansas dealer said.
Meanwhile, basis bids for hard red winter wheat were steady to lower, and new sales were slow.
